items.title: 3 Stocks for Higher Cash Yields as Rates Stay Elevated
items.summary: When interest rates climb quickly and government debt sits at record levels, cash suddenly feels powerful again. Short-duration cash and ultra-low-risk fixed-income vehicles can become a rare source of comfort when funding costs rise and AI-related borrowing heads toward an estimated US$600b by 2026. This article pinpoints 3 stocks tied to that story and explains how each one could help you rethink where your short-term money works hardest. The three examples below are only a starting sample...

items.title: 2 financials stocks worth your attention and 1 we find risky
items.summary: Financial providers use their expertise in capital allocation and risk assessment to help facilitate economic growth while offering consumers and businesses essential financial services. But uncertainty about fiscal and monetary policy has tempered enthusiasm, limiting the industry’s gains to 3.1% over the past six months. This return lagged the S&P 500’s 7.5% climb.

items.title: Is Bank of New York Mellon Corporation (BNY) Undervalued As Its Ripple Tie Up Expands?
items.summary: BNY (BNY) just expanded its collaboration with Ripple, tying its institutional custody platform directly into the XRP Ledger and Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin. This integration brings blockchain infrastructure into the bank’s existing servicing model. BNY’s move with Ripple lands at a time when the share price has had a mixed stretch in recent months, with a modest 7 day share price return of 1.88% but a 90 day share price return that is down 4.8%. items.title: BNY Holds $63 Trillion for Clients and Will Now Custody XRP. What If 0.1% of That Went Into XRP?
items.summary: BNY now custodies XRP for a bank holding $63 trillion in client assets, and XRP holders are already doing the math on what even a sliver of that figure could mean for the price. The case for optimism has a problem hiding in plain sight.

items.title: 3 market-beating stocks worth your attention
items.summary: Stocks that outperform the market usually share key traits such as rising sales, expanding margins, and increasing returns on capital. The select few that can do all three for many years are often the ones that make you life-changing money.
